in_arabic.name: Dorna
in_arabic.long_meaning: Dorna هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Persian word ‘dorah’, meaning ‘mountain’. It is a beautiful name with a strong and graceful meaning.

in_urdu.long_meaning: Dorna ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Persian word ‘dorah’, meaning ‘mountain’. It is a beautiful name with a strong and graceful meaning.

in_hindi.name: Dorna
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain

in_pashto.name: Dorna
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Mountain
